reviewer: Independent reviewer context t3_reviewer_b; correction review of one frozen dossier
reason: The revised partial claim repairs the material omitted named-body branch and distinguishes the original broad urban/community coordination commands from regional-council duties separately imposed by EO12149 and removed by EO12314. Fourteen original inventory units support first ends on August 17, 1982 within the bounded evidence reviewed. The two concrete statutory roster investigations are expressly unresolved, with null first ends; overall savings and accepted later-search closure are also withheld. These limitations prevent complete acceptance but do not contradict the asserted partial findings.

preserved_prior_rejection.effect: Unchanged. This correction review does not erase or recategorize the first-attempt rejection or alter root-controlled method-stop counts.

findings_upheld: The complete original EO12075 establishes an indefinite council. Its own terms contain no sunset, completion trigger, reporting deadline, or earlier termination. Inactivity and the generic EO12379 preamble do not establish an earlier actual end.

The inventory has 16 exact original-text units, not 16 numbered provisions: the 12 numbered provisions include section 1-102 partitioned into five contiguous roster units. The HEW and CSA entries are separately isolated; the other original units remain accounted for.

EO12148 section 5-210 adds FEMA to section 1-102; section 6 makes the amendment effective July 15, 1979. It adds membership rather than extinguishing an existing original command. Its section 2-302 saving concerns transferred section 1 emergency functions, not a surviving independent urban Council mandate.

EO12149 sections 1-204, 1-301 and 1-303 add actual ICC duties concerning regional referrals, policy/guidance and staff requests. EO12314 sections 3 and 4 assign regional-council oversight to OMB and revoke EO12149 on July 22, 1981. This terminates the separately added branch, but neither abolishes the ICC nor conflicts with every broad original EO12075 partnership, coordination, assistance and problem-solving command. The revised candidate no longer omits this branch.

EO12212 establishes May 4, 1980 as the Department of Education Organization Act effective date. It does not itself establish cessation of the HEW Council seat. The editorial HEW redesignation note is correctly treated as a lead requiring the actual successor-reference and savings provisions. No speculative earlier seat end is accepted.

The OFR EO12160 extract is a concrete editorial lead to CSA abolition under Public Law 97-35 and creation of the Office of Community Services. It does not settle the legal course of this Council seat. The CSA first end correctly remains null.

EO12379 is the actual actor identified from its complete text. Section 14 revokes EO12075 as amended; its complete ending establishes August 17, 1982, with no delayed effective date or target-specific saving. The 14 dated original units and the whole-order end date are upheld on the survival of independently continuing original commands, not an inference that every original seat necessarily first ended then.

EO12250 section 1-305 concerns the Rehabilitation Act section 507 council, a different statutory body. EO12407 revokes the Federal Regional Councils order EO12314 in 1983 without reviving the ICC or EO12149. The additional independently located EO13347 creates a distinct Homeland Security council concerning emergency preparedness and individuals with disabilities in 2004; it does not revive EO12075.

accepted_scope.cutoff_termination: Accepted as to the original EO12075 authorities after express revocation. This is not a determination that separately sourced statutory rights or functions ceased.
